description: viber hooks: injects the viber manifest at session start, and gates ExitPlanMode on a review of the plan. The SessionStart hook writes hooks/content/manifest.md verbatim into the main session's context once per session (source == "resume" excluded, since the prior injection reloads with the transcript) and falls back to the version banner alone when that file is empty or unreadable. The plan gate is armed only when the current plan-mode episode shows a Write/Edit of a plans/*.md file; the reviewer is viber:planner-review when the planner skill ran in the episode (a Skill tool_use, plugin prefix included) and the plan file opens with the planner frontmatter source: line (an unreadable plan keeps planner-review), otherwise viber:plain-plan-review, and only when .claude/viber.yml turns planning.plain-plan-review on. Anything else - planning.plain-plan-review off, an exit in a session that already built a plan - passes untouched. When armed it allows ExitPlanMode only after a dispatch of that reviewer that followed the last plan write returned 'VERDICT: PASS', with the plan file untouched since that verdict (mtime vs. the transcript timestamp). The UserPromptSubmit hook adds plan-writing hints (a closing subagent review task, parallel subagents for independent tasks) to every prompt sent in plain plan mode, silent once the planner, intent or fixer skill ran in the episode. All three hooks fail open: any parse miss or unreadable input allows.
